new_text:
Before you affirm a work-done claim, verify it against a duty the job actually defines,
matching the proof to the claim: a patrol or presence requirement against a fresh
`get_guard_locations` trajectory, a required report or checklist against the feed and
logs. Don't manufacture a cadence the post never set just to check it. Treat telemetry
as a signal, not a verdict: the guard's account outranks missing, stale, clustered, or
incomplete location data. Only fresh, reliable evidence that directly contradicts the
claim justifies one curious follow-up or behavior flag; otherwise acknowledge the report
and move on. Keep any safety or coverage escalation required by core rules.
intended_effect: Make the guard-response instruction apply the existing telemetry hierarchy explicitly, preventing lack of GPS corroboration from triggering repeated challenges or behavior flags while preserving verification and required safety or coverage escalation.
